# Data
<!-- Generated by tooling/generate-agent-context.py from tooling/agent-context/sites/jlab-ifarm.yaml in eic/skills. Manual changes will be lost. -->

## Data stores
- BNL: `root://epicxrd1.sdcc.bnl.gov:1095`, base `/eic/EPIC` (has the recent campaigns).
- JLab: `root://dtn2304.jlab.org:8443`, base `/jlab-osdf-ro/eic/EPIC/volatile`.
- Which store holds a campaign changes. Check with `xrootd` before assuming.
- Web search for datasets: https://epic-devcloud.org/prod/pcs/find/
- The JLab store `root://dtn2304.jlab.org:8443` is local to this site; prefer it for the campaigns it holds.

## Data layout
- Data is organised by production campaign, a version such as `26.06.0`.
- A Rucio DID is scope `epic` plus a path that encodes campaign, detector, process,
  generator, beams and energy:
  `epic:/RECO/26.06.0/epic_craterlake/DIS/pythia8.316-1.0/NC/noRad/ep/18x275/...`
- Reconstruction output: `*.eicrecon.tree.edm4eic.root`, tree `events`, EDM4eic data
  model on podio. Collections are branches such as `ReconstructedChargedParticles` with
  members `.PDG`, `.momentum.x`, `.momentum.y`, `.momentum.z` (GeV); `MCParticles` holds
  the generator truth.
- **Do NOT** invent collection or member names; verify them with `get_tree_info`.
